title: neonauclea pallida
intro: Neonauclea pallida, commonly known as the Pale Nauclea, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiparasitic effects. The therapeutic actions of Neonauclea pallida include its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-diarrheal, and anti-ulcerative agent, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which have been shown to exhibit significant pharmacological activities.
